scenarios.description: A narrow edit preserves its task contract and records passing implementation evidence.
evidenceTests: task v2 prompt and report bind goal, acceptance, revision and immutable hash

scenarios.description: Independent files can be offered in the same bounded dispatch wave.
evidenceTests: workflow offers independent tasks together within role and workflow limits

scenarios.description: Tasks sharing an interface contract are not dispatched in parallel.
evidenceTests: workflow rejects dependency cycles and avoids parallel shared-contract conflicts

scenarios.description: Passing checks do not bypass required semantic review and acceptance.
evidenceTests: task v2 cannot be accepted before independent review and stale source invalidates review
an open finding cannot be erased by omitting it from a later approved review

scenarios.description: Requirement ambiguity and environment failures route to different owners.
evidenceTests: failure routing uses deterministic signals and does not retry ambiguous work unchanged

scenarios.description: Restart reconciliation avoids duplicate work and late attempts do not settle the current task.
evidenceTests: workflow schedules only dependency-ready tasks and requires reconciliation before restart
workflow deduplicates settlements, ignores stale attempts, and enforces total call budget
